blocking_failures: behavior_in_tests: The instruction requires broad authorization preservation and a 50,000-requests-per-second, under-256-MiB resource target, but tests do not measure performance or memory and omit functions, virtual tables, triggers, attached databases, indirect access, malformed records, schema changes, and many other listed cases.
advice: pinned_dependencies: Although the base image, Debian packages in the Dockerfile, pytest, pytest-json-ctrf, and uv installer version are pinned, tests install curl without a version and rely on a remotely downloaded installer, so dependency pinning is not fully adequate.

test_deps_in_image: The Dockerfile installs jq, strace, and time even though they are test or diagnostic utilities and are not build requirements shown by the task. Test-only tooling should be isolated to the verifier rather than baked into the runtime image.
